Bilateral dorsal feet starfish-shaped keratotic lesions

panels.rationale: Whole-figure plate of 5 panels (A, B, C, D, E). A: Panel-specific caption states bilateral linear keratotic lesions at dorsum of MCP joints and wrist in article titled Vohwinkel syndrome with GJB2 mutation. Real patient clinical photo showing disease manifestation; no vocabulary key for linear lesions so coded as proposed. B: Caption and in-text describe honeycomb palmoplantar hyperkeratosis in Vohwinkel syndrome case; image shows diffuse palmar keratoderma. C: Caption explicitly states pseudoainhum at third and fourth toes, classic Vohwinkel mutilating feature, visible as constriction. D: Caption states starfish-shaped keratotic lesions of dorsal feet with in-text mention of starfish-shaped keratotic lesions; classic Vohwinkel finding. E: Histopathology from elbow plaque in Vohwinkel case captioned orthokeratotic hyperkeratosis H&E x100. Real patient histology; no vocabulary histology key so coded as proposed, attributed via disease-focused title plus captioned manifestation.

source_variants.context: Clinical photos show bilateral linear keratotic lesions of finger joints and wrist, honeycomb palmar keratoderma, toe pseudoainhum and starfish-shaped foot lesions, with H&E histology showing orthokeratotic hyperkeratosis.
source_variants.context_summary: Clinical photos show bilateral linear keratotic lesions of finger joints and wrist, honeycomb palmar keratoderma, toe pseudoainhum and starfish-shaped foot lesions, with H&E histology showing orthokeratotic hyperkeratosis.
source_variants.figure_caption: Physical examination and histopathology image. (A) Bilateral linear keratotic lesions at dorsum of metacarpophalangeal joints and right wrist. (B) Bilateral palmar keratoderma with “honeycomb” appearance. (C) Pseudoainhum at third and fourth toes. (D) Bilateral dorsal feet starfish-shaped keratotic lesions. (E) Orthokeratotic hyperkeratosis. (Hematoxylin & eosin, ×100).
